cases.sentence: Временная ___, балаган из досок, была построена подле самого гипподрома.
cases.translation: The temporary stable, a shed made of boards, was built right next to the hippodrome.
cases.explain: Конюшня is the grammatical subject of была построена (was built), so it is in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Едва он вышел из ___, как конюх его вызвал тренера.
cases.translation: As soon as he stepped out of the carriage, his groom summoned the trainer.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он отвернулся и подошел к ___ Фру-Фру.
cases.translation: He turned away and walked over to Frou-Frou's stall.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Вронский с удивлением приподнял ___ и посмотрел на англичанина.
cases.translation: Vronsky raised his head in surprise and looked at the Englishman.
cases.explain: Голову is the direct object of the transitive verb приподнял (raised), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он указывал большим с грязным ногтем ___ на денник гладиатора.
cases.translation: He pointed with his big, dirty-nailed finger at the gladiator's stall.
cases.explain: Пальцем is in the instrumental case because it names the instrument used, with no preposition required.

cases.sentence: Он решительно не знал, в каком ___ пришла и была его лошадь.
cases.translation: He had no idea in what condition his horse had arrived and now stood.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case here.

reading.ru: Временная конюшня, балаган из досок, была построена подле самого гипподрома, и туда вчера должна была быть приведена его лошадь.
reading.question: Where was the temporary stable built?
reading.correct: Right next to the hippodrome
reading.explain: The text says the shed was built right beside the hippodrome.

reading.ru: Едва он вышел из коляски, как конюх его, грум, так называемый мальчик, узнав еще издалека его коляску, вызвал тренера.
reading.question: What did the groom (boy) do when he recognized Vronsky's carriage from afar?
reading.correct: He called the trainer
reading.explain: Recognizing the carriage from a distance, the groom summoned the trainer.

reading.ru: В бараке стояло пять лошадей по денникам, и Вронский знал, что тут же нынче должен быть приведен и стоит его главный соперник, рыжий пятивершковый гладиатор Мохотина.
reading.question: Who was Vronsky's main rival horse mentioned here?
reading.correct: Gladiator, belonging to Makhotin
reading.explain: The text names Makhotin's chestnut Gladiator as Vronsky's main rival.

reading.ru: Но Вронский знал, что по законам приличия конской охоты не только нельзя видеть его, но неприлично и расспрашивать про него.
reading.question: According to the customs of horse racing, what was improper regarding a rival's horse?
options: Seeing it or even asking about it
reading.correct: Seeing it or even asking about it
reading.explain: Vronsky knew that by the rules of propriety it was improper even to ask about a rival's horse.

reading.ru: «С препятствиями все дело в езде и в плак», — сказал англичанин.
reading.question: According to the Englishman trainer, what mattered most with obstacles?
reading.correct: Riding skill and 'pluck' (courage)
reading.explain: The Englishman says everything with obstacles depends on riding and 'pluck'.

reading.ru: Фруфру была среднего роста лошадь и по статям небезукоризненная.
reading.question: How would Frou-Frou's conformation (build) be described?
options: Medium height and not flawless in build
reading.correct: Medium height and not flawless in build
reading.explain: The text says Frou-Frou was a horse of medium height, not irreproachable in build.

reading.ru: Это качество была кровь.
reading.question: What quality did Frou-Frou possess that made people forget her faults?
reading.correct: Her pedigree/blood (breeding)
reading.explain: The text says this quality was her blood, in the English sense of breeding.

reading.ru: Она была одной из тех животных, которые, кажется, не говорят только потому, что механическое устройство их рта не позволяет им этого.
reading.question: How did Vronsky perceive Frou-Frou's intelligence?
options: As if she could almost speak, only prevented by the mechanics of her mouth
reading.correct: As if she could almost speak, only prevented by the mechanics of her mouth
reading.explain: The text says she seemed like one of those animals that don't speak only because their mouths mechanically can't.

reading.ru: «О, милая, о!» — говорил Вронский, подходя к лошади и уговаривая ее.
reading.question: What did Vronsky say to Frou-Frou as he approached and tried to calm her?
reading.correct: 'Oh, my dear, oh!'
reading.explain: Vronsky says 'О, милая, о!' as he approaches and soothes her.

reading.ru: «Успокойся, милая, успокойся», — сказал он, погладив ее еще рукой по заду и с радостным сознанием, что лошадь в самом хорошем состоянии вышел из денника.
reading.question: With what feeling did Vronsky leave the stall?
options: Joyful awareness that the horse was in excellent condition
Fear that the horse was ill
reading.correct: Joyful awareness that the horse was in excellent condition
reading.explain: The text says he left with a joyful awareness that the horse was in very good condition.

reading.ru: Он чувствовал, что кровь приливала ему к сердцу и что ему так же, как и лошади, хочется двигаться, кусаться.
reading.question: How did the horse's excitement affect Vronsky?
options: He too felt his blood rushing and wanted to move and even bite
reading.correct: He too felt his blood rushing and wanted to move and even bite
reading.explain: He felt blood rushing to his heart and, like the horse, wanted to move and bite.

reading.ru: «Мне нужно к Брянскому.
reading.question: Where did Vronsky tell the Englishman he needed to go?
reading.correct: To Bryansky's
reading.explain: Vronsky says 'Мне нужно к Брянскому.'

reading.ru: «Алл-райт», — улыбаясь, отвечал Вронский и, вскочив в коляску, велел ехать в Петергов.
reading.question: Where did Vronsky order the carriage to go?
reading.correct: Peterhof
reading.explain: The text says he ordered the carriage to drive to Peterhof.

reading.ru: Едва он отъехал несколько шагов, как туча с утра, угрожавшая дождем, надвинулась и хлынул ливень.
reading.question: What happened just as Vronsky drove off?
reading.correct: A downpour began
reading.explain: A cloud that had threatened rain since morning burst into a downpour as he drove off.

reading.ru: Сидя в уединении закрытой коляски, он достал письмо матери и записку брата и прочел их.
reading.question: What did Vronsky do while sitting alone in the closed carriage?
options: He took out and read a letter from his mother and a note from his brother
reading.correct: He took out and read a letter from his mother and a note from his brother
reading.explain: Sitting in the closed carriage, he took out his mother's letter and his brother's note and read them.

reading.ru: Все, его мать, его брат, все находили нужно вмешиваться в его сердечные дела».
reading.question: What did Vronsky feel his mother and brother were doing?
options: Interfering in his personal love affairs
reading.correct: Interfering in his personal love affairs
reading.explain: He felt that everyone, his mother and brother, found it necessary to interfere in his affairs of the heart.

reading.ru: Эта женщина дороже для меня жизни, и это-то непонятно, и потому досадно им.
reading.question: How much did Vronsky value Anna, according to his own thoughts?
options: She was dearer to him than life itself
She meant nothing special to him
reading.correct: She was dearer to him than life itself
reading.explain: He thinks this woman is dearer to him than life.

reading.ru: Он чувствовал, что любовь, связывавшая его с Анной, не была минутное увлечение, которое пройдет, как проходят светские связи, не оставив других следов в жизни того и другого, кроме приятных или неприятных воспоминаний.
reading.question: How did Vronsky characterize his love for Anna?
options: Not a passing infatuation like ordinary society affairs
A mistake he wanted to end quickly
Something forced upon him by society
reading.correct: Not a passing infatuation like ordinary society affairs
reading.explain: He felt this love was not a momentary infatuation that would pass like ordinary society liaisons.

reading.ru: Он живо вспомнил все те часто повторявшиеся случаи необходимости лжи и обмана, которые были так противны его натуре.
reading.question: What did Vronsky recall that was so contrary to his nature?
options: The repeated instances of lying and deception their affair required
reading.correct: The repeated instances of lying and deception their affair required
reading.explain: He vividly recalled the frequent occasions of necessary lies and deceit, which were so repugnant to his nature.

reading.ru: И ему в первый раз пришла в голову ясная мысль о том, что необходимо прекратить эту ложь, и чем скорее, тем лучше.
reading.question: What clear thought came to Vronsky for the first time?
options: That it was necessary to put an end to the lying, the sooner the better
That he should give up racing
That he should marry someone else
That he should confront the Englishman
reading.correct: That it was necessary to put an end to the lying, the sooner the better
reading.explain: For the first time a clear thought came to him that this lie must end, the sooner the better.
